title: Thank you to @Goodspeed Musicals for inviting me to see this brand ne...
transcript: Y'all know I love a world premiere musical and I recently got invited to go to Good Speed Opera House in Connecticut to see the world premiere of the new musical The Snow Goose. The Snow Goose is a brand new musical about a young woman who finds an injured goose that leads her to start an unlikely friendship with a recluse artist outcast asked by society. And it was really exciting to see this at Good Speed Opera House, which has consistently been the starting point for so many new musicals, including Annie 50 years ago. And not only did I get to see behind the scenes where they build and paint all of their own sets, as well as their huge costume warehouse where they rent Broadway costumes to regional theatres across the country. But then after their performance, there was a talk back with the writers and director of The Snow Goose where they really gave us some insight into the developmental process of a new musical, as well as received feedback from the audience on what was working and what wasn't. And we really got to see a lot of the changes that they've already been making, include, including cutting two songs the day before. It is so exciting to me to get to see a musical find its footing and develop into what it's going to be, which is why I love the world premieres. And there's already so much to love about The Snow Goose from this incredibly emotional storyline that had me cheering up by the end of it. Some beautiful puppetry that was absolutely magical to watch on stage. And it's well integrated disability representation. I'm also somebody that loves a folk musical. So this new score was very much my vibe. Written by the same writers who wrote Kaylee, one of my favourite musicals from last year. I cannot wait to follow the journey of the Snow Goose. And there's just something so exciting to me about getting to discover a brand new world premiere musical, which you can find at regional theaters across the country, including The Snow Goose now playing at Goodspeed Opera House through October 18th.
